title: The Songuses
description: This project adds pretty weird stuff and OP stuff also.
body:
This mod contains some stuff like:

- Amongus people called Songus
- A flying robot called a Rocketeer that shoots rockets at you
- A robot called a Bastion that has a turret and shoots you if close
Songus people give a Songus Core that when you right click, you shoot a Core that explodes when touches a block
- 2 structures: Red Tower (contains 3 Songus and 3 Rocketeers), Bastion Cage (contains a bastion)
- Songus Sword (to craft put a stick in the bottom middle area, and 2 Songus Cores in the middle middle area and the top middle area in the crafting table)
- Bastion Sword (does alot of damage, and when you right click when holding the item, shoots a bullet)
- Awesome Pickaxe (a pickaxe that can be a sword and a pickaxe at the same time, also mines very fast)

These features are pretty weird, but pretty fun!
